statements.notes: Tart Cherry (Prunus cerasus) naturally contains polyphenolic antioxidant compounds such as quercetin, chlorogenic acid, and anthocyanins which can help fight free radicals that cause oxidative damage to the cells in our bodies.
This formulation provides the equivalent of 1000 mg (1g) of tart cherry in each vegetable capsule, derived from a premium quality 4:1 extract.

A traditional favorite Cherries have been consumed as food and medicine for thousands of years. As one of the main edible types of cherry, tart cherry's taste is a hallmark of delicious baked dishes such as cherry pie.
Solgar Tart Cherry formulation provides the health-supporting natural goodness of cherries without all the calories and sugar.
Emerging scientific research suggests antioxidant-rich cherries, including tart cherries, may possess varied health-promoting properties.
